hypothesis: Enforcing strict multi-drainage corridor alignment (>= 3 independent drainages along strike, fixing IR-68-UNALIGNED-01 where single-drainage candidates bypassed alignment) on a multi-scale 10 m 3DEP bedrock chi-slope contrast Delta_ksn = k_u - k_d (Perron & Royden 2013; Gailleton et al. 2019) coupled with true 10 m profile curvature (topo_10m_derived_100m_u8 band 6, fixing IR-68-TOPOBAND-01), 10 m slope_max (band 2), 1 m USGS 3DEP LiDAR cross-scarp / upface break (lidar_scarp_features_u8 bands 8 & 7), and basement-depth horizontal gradient (training_features band 15), masked for the 4 mandated confounds and thinned at min_sep_px = 3.0 px across anisotropic range-front corridors, passes E1 and substantially improves spatially-blocked HOLDOUT-DTI over H66-1, H65-1, and H60-A.
physical_mechanism: Active Basin-and-Range normal faults offset the range-front base level across a footwall-to-hanging-wall basement step; the resulting steepness contrast propagates upstream into transverse footwall drainages as a migrating chi-slope break (Delta_ksn > 0) aligned along fault strike across >= 3 independent drainages (Kirby & Whipple 2012, J. Struct. Geol. 44, 54-75; Perron & Royden 2013, ESPL 38, 570-576; Gailleton et al. 2019, ESurf 7, 211-230). Because 10 m channels are sparse (15.2% of footprint), coupling aligned channel knickpoints with 1 m LiDAR / 10 m piedmont profile-curvature breaks and anisotropic along-strike continuity bridges inter-drainage triangular-facet gaps along active range fronts, while strict n_drainage >= 3 filtering prevents isolated non-tectonic channel steps from consuming the 40,000-dot budget.
named_non_fault_mimic_process: Four non-fault processes mimic tectonic steepness steps and are explicitly masked: (1) flat ephemeral alluvial/desert washes (ksn_max < 10 m^0.9, 186,546 channel px) where un-floored log-ratios blow up kd ~ 0 into false steps; (2) playa / pluvial-lake base levels and saline clay flats (raised_n >= 50 or cond_surf > p95, 550,267 + 257,039 px); (3) unconsolidated basin-floor fill (depth_to_base_surf > p90, 516,432 px); and (4) intra-range resistant lithologic contacts (rel_elev > 180 m above 20 km median with shallow basement depth_to_base_surf < p25, 486,810 px), plus 40 km blockwise median/MAD standardization for regional climate/precipitation gradients and strict n_drainage >= 3 alignment against isolated single-stream boulder chokes.
